title: From A Hobby Project To The Leading AI Game Discovery Platform!
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
We started VibeToplist as a hobby project because we couldn't find a decent place to discover quality AI-assisted and vibe-coded games. Never expected it to blow up like this.

We're now approaching 500 game submissions, organic traffic is growing like crazy, and thousands of people are discovering new games through the platform every single day. It's also good to see that the sentiment is slowly starting to change, the mass adoption towards vibe coded games is already on-going, all the trends proof this.

Huge thanks to everyone who's been part of this journey! If you're building an AI-assisted game, you can still list it completely free, and benefit from the platform success.

[https://vibetoplist.com/](https://vibetoplist.com/)

comments.author: Fizassist1
comments.body: waiting for the day my game appears in one of your vids lol

replies.author: Fizassist1
replies.body: CheckPOW! is the only one I felt confident to post there

replies.author: CuntsAndBluntss
replies.body: It's doing pretty well I believe! Keep going at it.

comments.author: OopsAllMechanics
comments.body: Great idea! I think the name is perfect. I'll have to create an account and add my game once it's done.

comments.author: Scorchyy
comments.body: I don't like the fact people who pay get 250  votes every month and you started monetizing it and selling ads so early for it. It's too pay-to-win right now so I plan to remove my game from it.

comments.author: Objective_Froyo_8064
comments.body:
Plan on doing the same and adding my games to your site once I get my games to a more stable early access points.

But do agree with the other poster that it does feel pay to win, I don’t blame you or condemn you monetizing it. But wish it was not so detrimental to none paying devs.

comments.author: Scorchyy
comments.body: It’s not normal that someone starts the month with 250 votes because they paid, other games who can’t afford to pay can’t compete

replies.author: CuntsAndBluntss
replies.body:
I understand your concern, however this is normal for toplist. Toplist is not an entirely new invention. It's an iterated modernised iteration based on the AI-Assisted & vibe coded niche.

It's the same as Google Ads, they will always show on top. However, on VibeTopList we have a popular Discovery mode, on which users can swipe in random fashion. And each category on VibeTopList, has it's own ranking.

It's normal for the amount of unique traffic for a website to monitise it, since it's extremely cost heavy to even come to that point.

If you have any other questions, feel free to ask.
